mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_ugc_upload (owner_user_id, media_type, object_key, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, duration_seconds, status, expires_at) VALUES (#{upload.ownerUserId}, #{upload.mediaType}, #{upload.objectKey}, #{upload.mimeType}, #{upload.sizeBytes}, #{upload.sha256}, #{upload.durationSeconds}, 'STAGED', #{upload.expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_ugc_upload WHERE status = 'STAGED' AND expires_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY expires_at, id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE s_ugc_upload SET status = 'PURGED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'STAGED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_post_media (revision_id, position, media_type, storage_provider, object_key, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, duration_seconds, moderation_status, cleanup_status) VALUES (#{m.revisionId}, #{m.position}, #{m.mediaType}, #{m.storageProvider}, #{m.objectKey}, #{m.mimeType}, #{m.sizeBytes}, #{m.sha256}, #{m.durationSeconds}, #{m.moderationStatus}, 'ACTIVE')

INSERT INTO s_venue_review_media (revision_id, position, storage_provider, object_key, mime_type, size_bytes, sha256, moderation_status, cleanup_status) VALUES (#{m.revisionId}, #{m.position}, #{m.storageProvider}, #{m.objectKey}, #{m.mimeType}, #{m.sizeBytes}, #{m.sha256}, #{m.moderationStatus}, 'ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_post_media WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY position
SELECT * FROM s_post_media WHERE id = #{mediaId} AND cleanup_status != 'PURGED'

SELECT id,revision_id,position,'IMAGE' AS mediaType,storage_provider,object_key,mime_type, size_bytes,sha256,moderation_status,cleanup_status FROM s_venue_review_media WHERE id = #{mediaId} AND cleanup_status != 'PURGED'

SELECT m.id, m.revision_id, m.position, 'IMAGE' AS mediaType, m.storage_provider, m.object_key, m.mime_type, m.size_bytes, m.sha256, NULL AS durationSeconds, m.moderation_status, m.cleanup_status, m.purge_after, m.legal_hold FROM s_venue_review_media m WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY m.position

SELECT m.id, m.revision_id, m.position, 'IMAGE' AS mediaType, m.storage_provider, m.object_key, m.mime_type, m.size_bytes, m.sha256, NULL AS durationSeconds, m.moderation_status, m.cleanup_status, m.purge_after, m.legal_hold FROM s_venue_review_media m WHERE m.revision_id IN #{id} ORDER BY m.revision_id, m.position

SELECT m.* FROM s_post_media m JOIN s_post p ON p.public_revision_id = m.revision_id JOIN s_post_revision r ON r.id = m.revision_id WHERE m.id = #{mediaId} AND p.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.cleanup_status = 'ACTIVE' AND (p.author_type != 'USER' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM s_user_account u WHERE u.id = p.author_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL)) AND (p.author_type != 'USER' OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM s_user_block b WHERE (b.blocker_user_id = #{userId} AND b.blocked_user_id = p.author_id) OR (b.blocker_user_id = p.author_id AND b.blocked_user_id = #{userId})))

SELECT m.* FROM s_post_media m JOIN s_post_revision r ON r.id = m.revision_id JOIN s_post p ON p.id = r.post_id WHERE m.id = #{mediaId} AND p.author_type = 'USER' AND p.author_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.cleanup_status = 'ACTIVE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_user_account u WHERE u.id = p.author_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND u.deleted_at IS NULL)

SELECT m.id, m.revision_id, m.position, 'IMAGE' AS mediaType, m.storage_provider, m.object_key, m.mime_type, m.size_bytes, m.sha256 FROM s_venue_review_media m JOIN s_venue_review r ON r.public_revision_id = m.revision_id JOIN s_venue_review_revision rev ON rev.id = m.revision_id WHERE m.id = #{mediaId} AND r.content_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND rev.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.moderation_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.cleanup_status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT m.id, m.revision_id, m.position, 'IMAGE' AS mediaType, m.storage_provider, m.object_key, m.mime_type, m.size_bytes, m.sha256 FROM s_venue_review_media m JOIN s_venue_review_revision rev ON rev.id = m.revision_id JOIN s_venue_review r ON r.id = rev.review_id WHERE m.id = #{mediaId} AND r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.cleanup_status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO s_content_detection_job (content_type, revision_id, auto_publish) VALUES (#{contentType}, #{revisionId}, #{autoPublish})
mapper.select: SELECT status FROM s_content_detection_job WHERE content_type = #{contentType} AND revision_id = #{revisionId} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, content_type, revision_id, auto_publish FROM s_content_detection_job WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE s_content_detection_job SET status = #{status}, completed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{jobId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE s_post_media SET moderation_status = 'APPROVED' WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND moderation_status IN ('PENDING','REJECTED')
UPDATE s_venue_review_media SET moderation_status = 'APPROVED' WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND moderation_status IN ('PENDING','REJECTED')
UPDATE s_post_media SET moderation_status = 'REJECTED' WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND moderation_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE s_venue_review_media SET moderation_status = 'REJECTED' WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND moderation_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE s_post SET purge_after = #{purgeAfter} WHERE id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
UPDATE s_venue_review SET purge_after = #{purgeAfter} WHERE id = #{reviewId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
UPDATE s_post_comment SET purge_after = #{purgeAfter} WHERE id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
UPDATE s_venue_review_reply SET deleted_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), purge_after = #{purgeAfter} WHERE id = #{replyId} AND content_status = 'DELETED'
mapper.select: SELECT m.object_key FROM s_post_media m JOIN s_post_revision r ON r.id = m.revision_id JOIN s_post p ON p.id = r.post_id LEFT JOIN s_user_account u ON p.author_type = 'USER' AND u.id = p.author_id WHERE m.cleanup_status != 'PURGED' GROUP BY m.object_key HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN m.cleanup_status != 'PENDING' OR m.legal_hold = TRUE OR p.legal_hold = TRUE OR COALESCE(u.legal_hold,FALSE) = TRUE OR m.purge_after IS NULL OR m.purge_after > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 LIMIT 100

SELECT m.object_key FROM s_venue_review_media m JOIN s_venue_review_revision rev ON rev.id = m.revision_id JOIN s_venue_review r ON r.id = rev.review_id JOIN s_user_account u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE m.cleanup_status != 'PURGED' GROUP BY m.object_key HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN m.cleanup_status != 'PENDING' OR m.legal_hold = TRUE OR r.legal_hold = TRUE OR u.legal_hold = TRUE OR m.purge_after IS NULL OR m.purge_after > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE s_post_media SET cleanup_status = 'PURGED' WHERE object_key = #{objectKey} AND cleanup_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE s_venue_review_media SET cleanup_status = 'PURGED' WHERE object_key = #{objectKey} AND cleanup_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE s_post_media m JOIN s_post_revision r ON r.id = m.revision_id SET m.cleanup_status = 'ACTIVE', m.purge_after = NULL WHERE r.post_id = #{postId} AND m.cleanup_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE s_venue_review_media m JOIN s_venue_review_revision r ON r.id = m.revision_id SET m.cleanup_status = 'ACTIVE', m.purge_after = NULL WHERE r.review_id = #{reviewId} AND m.cleanup_status = 'PENDING'

choose.when: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_post_media m JOIN s_post_revision r ON r.id = m.revision_id WHERE r.post_id = #{targetId} AND m.cleanup_status = 'PURGED')
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM s_venue_review_media m JOIN s_venue_review_revision r ON r.id = m.revision_id WHERE r.review_id = #{targetId} AND m.cleanup_status = 'PURGED')
